description: This file implements a Microsoft speech provider plugin for a text-to-speech system, including configuration normalization, voice listing, and synthesis functions.

methods.name: normalizeMicrosoftProviderConfig
methods.description: Normalizes raw configuration data into a structured MicrosoftProviderConfig object.

methods.name: readMicrosoftProviderConfig
methods.description: Reads and applies default values to a given SpeechProviderConfig to produce a MicrosoftProviderConfig.

methods.name: buildMicrosoftVoiceHeaders
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers for Microsoft voice API requests.

methods.name: formatMicrosoftVoiceDescription
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for a voice entry based on its Personalities.

methods.name: listMicrosoftVoices
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of available Microsoft voices.

methods.name: buildMicrosoftSpeechProvider
methods.description: Creates and returns a Microsoft speech provider plugin object with configuration, voice listing, and synthesis capabilities.
